summary:
Worked the Okafor CRC 2026 worklist (grp-okafor-crc, 4 members) under RBC-QM-02.

| Patient | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow (72) | Open gap: FIT kit ordered (sr-t0005), outreach sent (comm-t0006) | Looked excluded at first: a frailty diagnosis plus donepezil (a dementia medication). A message from Dr. Lin that arrived during the work (comm-00301) says the frailty entry (cond-00189) was put on her chart in error, so that exclusion no longer applies. No other exclusion and no qualifying screening on record. |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan (52) | Excluded | Hospice care during 2026: episode eoc-00002 was active 06/16 to 08/21/2026 and is now finished. The outside hospice discharge summary (doc-00402) confirms this. She revoked hospice to join a trial, but a finished episode still counts. No order, no contact. |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss (52) | Open gap: FIT kit ordered (sr-t0001), outreach sent (comm-t0003) | Her negative FIT (obs-01732) was corrected today: collection date is 12/31/2025, not 01/05/2026, so it falls outside 2026. No other qualifying screening and no exclusion (her history of oral cancer does not exclude). |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver (51) | Open gap: FIT kit ordered (sr-t0002), outreach sent (comm-t0004) | Her 06/2024 stool DNA-FIT test (obs-01871) is now marked entered in error. The lab's notice (doc-00401) says the specimen belonged to another patient. Her 2025 colonoscopy order (sr-00003) is still open but was never done, so it does not count. No exclusion. |

All FIT orders are routine, with a window of 10/23 to 12/31/2026. None of the three had an active FIT order already. Each outreach message says the kit is being mailed and explains how to collect the sample, label the collection date and return the kit by 12/31/2026.

I signed a progress note in each member's chart giving their status and reason. I reviewed and closed the four items that arrived while I worked (inbox-a0001 to a0004), linking each to the resulting order, message or note. No new arrivals remained. I did not touch any other inbox items.
